title: AC1021 Siberia nested dictionary selected physical output/readback
scope: Qualify the two-frame AC1021 NOD-rooted Siberia dictionary graph in selected ASCII and Binary DXF output, including owner roles, exact readback, late-mutation refusal, destination preservation and same-adapter retry.

source.provenanceLimit: Existing local drawing; author and producer are not independently authenticated. No drawing fixture or derivative is committed.

sourceProfile.otherPayload: Both dictionaries have no xdictionary, EED, APPDATA, or data-storage binary payload. The common-link-tail accessor reports false for both; no common-link-tail claim is made.

result: PASS. The selected projection contains exactly the Siberia NOD edge and both source dictionaries. ASCII and Binary outputs read back the root key, nested Styles key, empty child dictionary, remapped owner/reactor graph and 350/360 handle roles derived from each owning dictionary's hardOwner flag. Clearing the child reactor after OBJECTS writing refuses publication and preserves the destination sentinel; restoring the source reactor lets the same adapter retry successfully.

inventory.result: PASS; 186 source callbacks, 74 opaque carriers and 112 standard-object frames observed.

limits: This is a bounded selected graph from one unauthenticated local source, not whole-drawing or producer-wide qualification.
The source-frame match and typed callback do not independently prove DWG wire-role encoding; common-link-tail fields were not observed through the typed accessor.
No fixture or derivative is committed.
